name: beemarketing-promo
description: Film promotionnel BeeMarketing (60 s, 9:16 et 16:9) — HyperFrames + Remotion

scripts.render:9x16: remotion render remotion/index.ts BeeMarketing-9x16 exports/raw_9x16.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --crf=16 && bash scripts/finalize.sh exports/raw_9x16.mp4 exports/BeeMarketing_Promo_60s_9x16.mp4
scripts.render:16x9: remotion render remotion/index.ts BeeMarketing-16x9 exports/raw_16x9.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --crf=16 && bash scripts/finalize.sh exports/raw_16x9.mp4 exports/BeeMarketing_Promo_60s_16x9.mp4
scripts.build: npm run music && npm run hf:render && npm run typecheck && npm run render:9x16 && npm run render:16x9 && npm run srt
